name: Issues
description: This project's issues, kept on this computer only: each one a file in .prism/issues, its own git repository with no remote, so every change has its history and nothing is ever published.
agent: The project's own issue list, local only (never on GitHub). File what you find with issue_create (the exact file:line, what goes wrong, how to see it); read with issue_list / issue_get; add what you learn with issue_note; when a commit fixes one, issue_resolve with that commit's hash.
